invariants.rule: iOS Phase 2.1 must first run implement-slices --dry-run --backend auto and bind sub-agent/channel/inline execution to the returned dispatcher plan rather than selecting channel first.
invariants.positive_case: Both iOS workflow copies contain the dry-run command, selected_backend/decision/dispatch item language, Active task prelude, and nested-dispatch guard.
invariants.negative_case: iOS workflow still says to choose a backend directly from codex.dispatch_mode without reading implement-slices dry-run output.
test_evidence: rg implement-slices dry-run in iOS source and mirror

invariants.rule: iOS platform-specific implementation order and hard rules must remain present after adding the dispatcher prelude.
invariants.positive_case: The iOS workflow still names ios-implementation-guru-writing and preserves domain-model to view ordering, FactoryKit DI, Repository ownership, ViewModel, private extension, and WCDBSwift constraints.
invariants.negative_case: The dispatcher edit deletes or weakens iOS layer ordering, FactoryKit injection, Repository boundary, ViewModel state, or WCDBSwift persistence rules.
test_evidence: rg iOS platform guard terms in iOS source and mirror

invariants.rule: iOS [workflow-state:in_progress] breadcrumb must be dispatch-mode aware and must not describe channel as the default implementation backend.
invariants.positive_case: Both iOS workflow copies tell the main session to run implement-slices --dry-run --backend auto, choose backend from selected_backend, preserve the Active task prelude, forbid nested implement/check spawn, respect dispatch_now/deferred_slices, and keep the validation-evidence reminder within the install breadcrumb budget.
invariants.negative_case: The iOS in_progress breadcrumb still says default official trellis channel or omits the dispatcher dry-run prelude.
test_evidence: rg iOS in_progress breadcrumb dispatcher wording
